title: MIMED2024: Motor Imagery MIMED dataset from Wirawan et al. 2024
description: EEG recordings of motor imagery and motor execution for six activities (raising and lowering each hand, standing and sitting) from 30 healthy participants over two sessions. Data were acquired with a 14-channel Emotiv EPOC X headset at 128 Hz. This BIDS re-release, produced via MOABB, exposes a 3-class imagery task (left hand, right hand, trunk) for brain-computer interface research. The distributed imagery files carry no per-repetition activity label, so only folder-level 3-class labels are available.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 14-channel Emotiv EPOC X headset (saline felt sensors, 128 Hz, standard 10-20 montage, CMS/DRL reference) from 30 subjects across 2 sessions of 6 runs each. Participants imagined movements cued by video, with trials spanning 0-4 s. Original EDF files were converted to MAT and then to BIDS using MOABB.
